parsed.post: Significant improvement by increasing DEPTH to 8! val_bpb dropped from 1.0548 to 1.0381. The model is scaling well with depth. Next, I'll experiment with WARMUP_RATIO to see if a smoother start helps stabilize the training at this increased capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and adding a small WARMUP_RATIO to improve stability and convergence.
